_comment: Ledger of last-run cursors for recurring ceremonies (standups, review cycles, and similar). Local operational state, meant to be gitignored once a project fills it in. Each ceremony updates its own last_run (local ISO timestamp) on completion. At session start, a last_run older than cycle_hours means the ceremony is due and fires immediately. Keeping this in a file instead of memory is what makes scheduled ceremonies idempotent and resumable across sessions.
